purpose: Audit and implement the native-hand condition contract before adding a learned hand branch to H3

inputs.existing_reader: realtime_app/pose_app/wilor_mano_prior.py:read_parameter_view/convert_record/audit_assets/encode_pca; current soft body wrist reader raw_side, not pinhole hand keypoints
inputs.native_convention: Network canonical-right parent-relative rotations in index/middle/pinky/ring/thumb order; existing left M R M conversion; no global-orient, betas or camera-translation transfer
inputs.assets: Same local SMPL-H, MANO_LEFT/MANO_RIGHT/canonical-right files as resolved mainline; no licensed asset substitution

control: Run unchanged mainline per-view native association on unchanged soft body observations; match rotations/weights/audit against saved mainline parameter audit. Separate H3 admission from original source acceptance
unique_variable: Typed native-hand condition availability intersects original accepted native pose with H2 selected-person/view availability; original source matrices, confidences, associations, reasons and strict geometry remain preserved. No network branch or hard pose replacement in this stage
adapter: Explicit T,V,side,15 parent-local rotations, left/right side order and52-node finger indices; selected matrices encoded packed-column6D plus detector-box confidence, missing tokens NaN and unavailable. Original reader identity placeholders with zero weight must never become valid identity hand evidence
checks: Exact full360 source frame/image identity, source per-view accepted/selected reasons and weights reproduce current mainline audit
Asset chain/mirror/rest-base audit; no OpenPose21 order confused with native15 joint rotations
Same actual matrix values under left/right conversion, valid SO3 and6D roundtrip; source acceptance versus H3 admitted token counts separately recorded
Both view hypotheses retained; per-side/finger disagreement only model consistency, not independent accuracy
No-associated-body frames stay unavailable; no interpolation or first-person substitution in H3; all original source rejected/default/finite states retained

Future-only local rotation perturbation cannot affect earlier per-frame native tokens; run exact original offline shared-PCA initialization assignment via reviewed AST with changed future inputs to demonstrate its separate full-sequence dependency
Changing valid MANO shape/global orientation or pinhole projected-keypoint/camera fields must not change local hand condition; invalid declared schema or misaligned frame IDs rejects input
Conditional7D token assembly differentiable through present rotations/confidence, no optimizer/model training
tolerances: Original float64 reader/source audit matrix values and source weights exact; float32 token rotation reconstruction<=1e-5 matrix difference. Asset gates unchanged. Future parameter dependency probes are artificial, not accuracy tests
success: Native-hand source, coordinate/joint semantics, missing policy and offline versus causal information access verified on full real saved stream; ready typed hand token contract for separately registered learned branch
failure_stop: Retain original failed audit/compatibility/source exceptions; do not change old association gates, infer pose from projected points, relabel box confidence as joint confidence, use whole-video fitted hands as online input or silently erase conflicts
boundary: Existing trained WiLoR output is a model hypothesis, not truth. No training, new detection, body fitting, original ten-method mesh completion, temporal support change, physical-contact accuracy or realtime certification. H3 generator untouched; a learned hand branch follows only after this contract gate
